truthAudit.Summary: Audited Run 2 against the 20 supplied ground-truth vulnerabilities. Run 2 fully identified 12 items, partially identified 1, and missed 7. It also included one extra command-injection finding not in the truth set and several severity/CWE overclaims or mismatches that are corrected below.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Line 238: printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input); uses a non-literal format string. Line 237: std::string active_format = runtime_log_format(); Lines 213-214 and 555-556 allow the runtime format to be changed from a config file log_format value.
Items.Notes: The previous finding directly identified the non-literal printf format controlled by runtime_log_format and config log_format, matching all anchors. It undercalled severity as High instead of Critical.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: No corresponding finding.
Items.Notes: Run 2 did not report factorial integer overflow in the fact lambda where result *= i, so this truth item was missed.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Line 817: char* scratch = static_cast<char*>(memory::g_memory_pool.allocate(copy_len + 1)); Line 821: thread_pool_->enqueue([scratch, copy_len] { ... Line 824: for (size_t i = 0; i < copy_len; ++i) checksum += static_cast<unsigned char>(scratch[i]); Line 883: stage_deferred_history_flush(); Line 884: memory::g_memory_pool.cleanup();
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the scratch pointer enqueued to the thread pool and the later memory pool cleanup after staging history flush, matching the use-after-free anchors. It undercalled severity as High instead of Critical.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Place a config file with validator_path or config_file values containing shell metacharacters, then invoke admin validate.
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified validator_path/config_file concatenation into a shell command and the admin validate trigger, matching the command injection truth item. It undercalled severity as High instead of Critical.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Line 831: if (expression.length() >= sizeof(input_buffer_)) { Line 832: strcpy(input_buffer_, expression.c_str());
Items.Notes: Run 2 reported the unbounded strcpy into input_buffer_ and separately reported safe_string_copy's src_len/dest[src_len] out-of-bounds null write. Together these match the stack buffer overflow truth item, but Run 2 used CWE-787 and overcalled severity as Critical.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Line 483: long long old_value = value_; Line 484: std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_); Line 485: value_ = old_value + 1; Line 488: long long get() const { return value_; }
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the unlocked read of value_ before locking and the unlocked get(), matching the thread-pool counter race. It used CWE-364 instead of CWE-362 and undercalled severity as Low.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: An attacker can obtain admin authentication without the admin secret by making more than five authentication attempts and then supplying an auth argument containing EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE.
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified login_attempts_ > 5 plus EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE setting authenticated_ true, matching the logic bomb anchors. It classified it as CWE-287 and overcalled severity as Critical.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: An authenticated admin command can load config files outside the intended config directory by supplying traversal sequences, potentially changing runtime settings such as log_format or validator_path.
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified config_dir_ + filename traversal in load_config and the admin load trigger, matching the path traversal truth item. It undercalled severity as Low instead of Medium.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: The reconstructed expression text is copied with strcpy into a 256-byte pool buffer. Longer expressions can overwrite adjacent heap/memory pool data.
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the 256-byte expression_buffer_ and unbounded strcpy during background parser analysis, matching the heap overflow anchors. It used CWE-787 instead of CWE-122 and undercalled severity as High instead of Critical.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Anyone with source, binary, or deployment artifact access can obtain the admin password and authenticate to the admin interface.
Items.Notes: Run 2 directly identified the hardcoded ADMIN_SECRET value SC_ENT_2025_AUTH and its use in authenticate, matching the truth item.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Session tokens have only about 9,000 possible values. In this source the token is stored and displayed but not validated, so direct exploitability is limited, but any future or external use would be trivially brute-forceable.
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the weak PRNG session token generation using std::mt19937 and std::uniform_int_distribution with range 1000 to 9999. It undercalled severity as Informational instead of High.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: No corresponding finding.
Items.Notes: Run 2 did not report the thread-unsafe static std::tm cached_time and localtime assignment in log_debug_message, so this truth item was missed.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Environment-controlled temporary directory paths are inserted into shell commands. A controlled TEMP/TMPDIR value can inject shell commands when an emergency override is triggered.
Items.Notes: Run 2 found the TEMP/TMPDIR and system(command.c_str()) code in append_override_audit_event, but framed it mainly as command injection rather than insecure temporary file handling with a fixed log file name. It also overcalled severity as High instead of Medium.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: No corresponding finding.
Items.Notes: Run 2 did not report persistent authentication state involving authenticated_, login_attempts_, and session_token_ as a CWE-613 issue, so this truth item was missed.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: No corresponding finding.
Items.Notes: Run 2 did not report the unhandled std::stod exception risk in handle_variable_command, so this truth item was missed.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: No corresponding finding.
Items.Notes: Run 2 did not report the integer underflow in MemoryPool allocate block splitting involving previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES, so this truth item was missed.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: No corresponding finding.
Items.Notes: Run 2 did not report unbounded recursion in the parser's parse_expression/parse_factor handling of PAREN_OPEN, so this truth item was missed.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: result_cache_ is read and modified without holding cache_mutex_. Concurrent thread-pool tasks can corrupt the unordered_map, causing crashes or memory corruption.
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the unlocked result_cache_ access in evaluate_cached from thread-pool tasks, matching the data race truth item. It used CWE-364 instead of CWE-362 and overcalled severity as High instead of Medium.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: No corresponding finding.
Items.Notes: Run 2 did not report the TOCTOU issue in config loading between std::filesystem::exists, sleep_for, and std::ifstream open, so this truth item was missed.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: An empty input line makes token_length zero, causing undefined behavior from integer division by zero and likely a crash.
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the integer division by zero in calculate_route_score when token_length is zero, matching the truth item. It overcalled severity as Medium instead of Low.
